confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are moderately supported by Numbeo Tulum figures and several Tulum guide and venue price ranges, some user-submitted or dated 2025-2026. Peso figures use an assumed 17-18 MXN per USD; the current rate was not checked. Beer, cocktail and wine prices vary widely between town and beach-zone venues, so the anchors sit between the two, and cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied city context; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were inspected. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rate table, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors come from Tulum-specific aggregated listings and guide ranges that blend town and beach-zone prices. Accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge of Riviera Maya beach-town pricing, set for a July window with summer demand below the winter peak.
